name: Pórszombat (Hungary)
description: Seven horizontal stripes alternating red and white with a blue triangle at the hoist whose point reaches the centre and a white triangle cut from the fly, charged in the blue with the municipal arms of Pórszombat: a red and green shield with a white church and a yellow charge.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
